tasks.label: Dev Container: 后端服务
tasks.command: test -f /.dockerenv && set -a && if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/.env" ]; then . "${workspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/.env"; fi && set +a && mvn spring-boot:run

tasks.label: Dev Container: 前端服务
tasks.command: test -f /.dockerenv && set -a && if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/.env" ]; then . "${workspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/.env"; fi && set +a && npm run dev

tasks.label: Dev Container: 验证项目
tasks.command: test -f /.dockerenv && mvn -B -f backend/pom.xml test -Dagent.model.enabled=false && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
